general: Generate a production-quality portrait asset atlas for a dark science-fiction tabletop gang roster app. ONE atlas containing exactly 24 different individual portraits in a mathematically regular 4-column by 6-row grid. Target canvas 1024 x 1536, every square cell exactly one quarter width and one sixth height. Zero outer margin, zero gutters, no border lines, no printed text, no role labels, no numbers, no watermark or logos. Each cell must be a complete distinct portrait centered in its own square, with safe room around the head/helmet and shoulders. Flat dark industrial background within each cell; never a single group scene stretching across cells. Realistic grimdark painted / photographic hybrid, worn detailed materials, restrained directional cinematic lighting, strong readable face/helmet at tiny mobile size. Same coherent quality and lighting across all cells, varied distinct adult faces/helmets/gender, different individuals, all human characters explicitly adults. No generic silhouettes or empty cells. No UI mockup. Use supplied faction art as visual grounding for clothing/material/palette but create different individual characters. Keep anatomy appropriate for the named faction/species. The output will be sliced into individual square WebP app assets, so keep all subjects inside exact cell boundaries.
humanoidRows: ROW 1: four different LEADERS, visibly experienced commanders, distinctive ornate rank insignia made from faction-appropriate armor and relics, confident authoritative gaze.
ROW 2: four different CHAMPIONS, hardened elite veterans, specialist battle armor, disciplined imposing gaze; less ceremonial than leaders.
ROW 3: four different GANGERS, practical rank-and-file adult fighters, worn utilitarian faction equipment, varied readable personalities.
ROW 4: four MORE different GANGERS, entirely new faces/helmets from row3; practical rank-and-file faction equipment.
ROW 5: four different PROSPECTS / young-adult recruits, explicitly adult, lighter patched gear and simpler faction insignia, eager or wary expressions, never children.
ROW 6: four different SUPPORT specialists: a field medic, a mechanic, an ammunition quartermaster, and a scout/informant, all with faction-appropriate practical tools and mature adult appearance.

insectoid: four different giant chitinous arthropod brutes, multiple eyes and armored mandibles, ant/spider/crab-like heads, no humanoid face

rodent: four different giant rat-like underhive companions, whiskers, alert eyes, scavenged harnesses, distinct rodent anatomy
